questions.question: An administrator needs to rapidly deploy a popular IT solution and start using it immediately. Where can the administrator find assistance?
questions.explanation: AWS Quick Start reference deployments are prebuilt, automated templates that let you rapidly deploy popular IT solutions and start using them immediately. The Well-Architected docs, CloudFront, and CodeCommit do not provide turnkey deployments.

questions.question: What is one of the advantages of the Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS)?

options.text: It simplifies relational database administration tasks.
It automatically scales databases for loads.
It enables users to dynamically adjust CPU and RAM resources.

questions.explanation: A key advantage of Amazon RDS is that it simplifies relational database administration — AWS handles provisioning, patching, backups, and recovery. The fabricated durability figure, automatic load scaling, and dynamic CPU/RAM tuning are not how RDS is described.

questions.question: Which of the following AWS Cloud services can be used to run a customer-managed relational database?
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 lets you run a customer-managed (self-installed) relational database with full control of the OS and engine. Route 53 is DNS, ElastiCache is a cache, and DynamoDB is NoSQL.

questions.question: A user is planning to launch two additional Amazon EC2 instances to increase availability. Which action should the user take?

options.text: Launch the instances across multiple Availability Zones in a single AWS Region.
Launch the instances as EC2 Reserved Instances in the same AWS Region and the same Availability Zone.
Launch the instances in multiple AWS Regions but in the same Availability Zone.
Launch the instances as EC2 Spot Instances in the same AWS Region but in different Availability Zones.

questions.explanation: Launching the additional instances across multiple Availability Zones in a single Region increases availability by surviving an AZ failure. Same-AZ or single-AZ-across-Regions placements do not improve availability the same way.

questions.question: Which of the following can limit Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket access to specific users?

options.text: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies.

questions.explanation: IAM policies control which users and roles can access a specific S3 bucket. Key pairs are for instance login, Inspector scans for vulnerabilities, and security groups filter network traffic.

questions.question: Which AWS service allows companies to connect an Amazon VPC to an on-premises data center? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: AWS VPN (A) (encrypted internet tunnel) and AWS Direct Connect (D) (dedicated private link) both connect an Amazon VPC to an on-premises data center. Redshift and API Gateway are not connectivity services.

questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can be used to monitor CPU usage?
questions.explanation: Amazon CloudWatch monitors metrics such as CPU usage for EC2 instances. CloudTrail logs API calls, VPC Flow Logs capture network traffic, and Config tracks configuration.

questions.question: Which task is AWS responsible for in the shared responsibility model for security and compliance?

options.text: Granting access to individuals and services.

questions.explanation: AWS is responsible for updating the firmware of the underlying EC2 host hardware. Granting access, encrypting data in transit, and updating guest operating systems are customer responsibilities.

questions.question: Which of the following security-related actions are available at no cost?

options.text: Contacting AWS Professional Services to request a workshop.
Attending AWS classes at a local university.

questions.explanation: Accessing AWS forums, blogs, and whitepapers is free. Calling Support (beyond Basic), Professional Services workshops, and university classes generally have a cost.

questions.question: Which storage service can be used as a low-cost option for hosting static websites?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 is a low-cost option for hosting static websites (HTML, CSS, JS, images). Glacier is archival, DynamoDB is a database, and EFS is a file system.

questions.question: According to the AWS shared responsibility model what is the sole responsibility of AWS?
questions.explanation: Edge location management is the sole responsibility of AWS (part of the global infrastructure). Application security, patch management (guest OS), and client-side data are customer responsibilities.

questions.question: Which of the following are pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Performance efficiency (B) and Security (C) are pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework (along with Operational Excellence, Reliability, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability). Multiple AZs, encryption, and 'high availability' are practices, not pillars.

questions.question: Which AWS service identifies security groups that allow unrestricted access to a user’s AWS resources?
questions.explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor flags security groups that allow unrestricted (open) access to your resources, among other best-practice checks. Inspector assesses vulnerabilities, CloudWatch monitors, and CloudTrail logs.

questions.question: Which design principles for cloud architecture are recommended when re-architecting a large monolithic application? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: When re-architecting a monolith, implement loose coupling (C) and design for scalability (E). Manual monitoring, fixed servers, and reliance on individual (tightly coupled) components are anti-patterns.

questions.question: When architecting cloud applications, which of the following are a key design principle?
questions.explanation: Implementing elasticity — scaling resources up and down automatically with demand — is a key cloud design principle. Oversized instances, peak-load provisioning, and a specific dev methodology are not.

questions.question: A company has deployed several relational databases on Amazon EC2 instances. Every month the database software vendor releases new security patches that need to be applied to the databases. What is the MOST efficient way to apply the security patches?

options.text: Connect to each database instance on a monthly basis and download and apply the necessary security patches from the vendor.
Enable automate patching for the instances using the Amazon RDS console.
In AWS Config. configure a rule for the instances and the required patch level.
Use AWS Systems Manager to automate database patching according to a schedule.

questions.explanation: Because the databases run on EC2 (not RDS), AWS Systems Manager is the most efficient way to automate patching across the instances on a schedule. RDS automated patching does not apply to self-managed EC2 databases, and Config only evaluates compliance.

questions.question: Which mechanism allows developers to access AWS services from application code?
questions.explanation: The AWS SDKs let developers access AWS services directly from application code in their preferred language. The Console is graphical, CodePipeline is CI/CD, and Config tracks configuration.

questions.question: Which AWS feature will reduce the customer’s total cost of ownership (TCO)?
questions.explanation: Elastic computing reduces TCO by letting you scale capacity to actual demand instead of over-provisioning and paying for idle resources. The shared responsibility model, single tenancy, and encryption do not directly lower TCO.

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of using the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Permissive security removes the administrative burden.
Ability to focus on revenue-generating activities.
Choice of specific cloud hardware vendors.

questions.explanation: A benefit of the AWS Cloud is the ability to focus on revenue-generating (business) activities instead of managing infrastructure. AWS does not remove security responsibility, and you do not control or choose the physical hardware.

questions.question: Which of the following are categories of AWS Trusted Advisor? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Trusted Advisor categories include Fault Tolerance (A) and Performance (D) (plus Cost Optimization, Security, and Service Limits). 'Instance Usage,' 'Infrastructure,' and 'Storage Capacity' are not categories.

questions.question: What is Amazon CloudWatch?

options.text: A code repository with customizable build and team commit features.
A metrics repository with customizable notification thresholds and channels.
A security configuration repository with threat analytics.
A rule repository of a web application firewall with automated vulnerability prevention features.

questions.explanation: Amazon CloudWatch is a metrics repository with customizable alarms (notification thresholds) and notification channels. It is not a code repo, a security config store, or a WAF rule repository.

questions.question: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which of the following activities are the customer’s responsibility? (Select TWO)

options.text: Patching operating system components for Amazon Relational Database Server (Amazon RDS).
Maintaining environmental controls within a data center.

questions.explanation: Customers are responsible for encrypting data client-side (B) and configuring Network ACLs (D). RDS OS patching, data-center staff training, and environmental controls are AWS responsibilities.

questions.question: Under the shared responsibility model, which of the following is a shared control between a customer and AWS?
questions.explanation: Patch management is a shared control: AWS patches the infrastructure while customers patch their guest OS and applications. Physical controls, zone security, and data-center auditing are AWS-owned.

questions.question: Which AWS service is used to pay AWS bills, and monitor usage and budget costs?
questions.explanation: AWS Billing and Cost Management is used to pay bills and monitor usage and budgeted costs. Consolidated billing is a feature within it, CloudWatch monitors metrics, and QuickSight is BI.

questions.question: How do customers benefit from Amazon’s massive economies of scale?

options.text: Periodic price reductions as the result of Amazon’s operational efficiencies.
New Amazon EC2 instance types providing the latest hardware.
The ability to scale up and down when needed.
Increased reliability in the underlying hardware of Amazon EC2 instances.

questions.explanation: Customers benefit from Amazon's economies of scale through periodic price reductions driven by AWS's operational efficiencies. New instance types, scaling ability, and hardware reliability are separate benefits.

questions.question: Which AWS feature allows a company to take advantage of usage tiers for services across multiple member accounts?
questions.explanation: Consolidated billing combines usage across member accounts so they can collectively reach volume pricing tiers. SCPs restrict actions, Reserved Instances are a purchase model, and Cost Explorer analyzes spend.

questions.question: Which AWS services provide a way to extend an on-premises architecture to the aws cloud? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: AWS Storage Gateway (C) and AWS Direct Connect (E) extend an on-premises architecture into AWS (hybrid storage and dedicated connectivity). EBS, Connect, and CloudFront do not provide hybrid extension here.

questions.question: Which of the following services will automatically scale with an expected increase in web traffic?
questions.explanation: Elastic Load Balancing automatically scales its own capacity to handle increasing web traffic and distributes it across targets. CodePipeline, EBS, and Direct Connect do not auto-scale for web traffic.

questions.question: Which service provides a virtually unlimited amount of online highly durable object storage?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 provides virtually unlimited, highly durable (11 nines) online object storage. Redshift is analytics, EFS is file storage, and ECS runs containers.

questions.question: Which AWS feature should a customer leverage to achieve high availability of an application?
questions.explanation: Deploying across multiple Availability Zones is the feature that delivers high availability by tolerating the failure of a single AZ. Direct Connect, individual data centers, and VPC do not by themselves provide HA.

questions.question: Which AWS service or feature can enhance network security by blocking requests from a particular network for a web application on AWS? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: AWS WAF (A) blocks malicious web requests (e.g., by IP) and Network ACLs (E) block traffic at the subnet level; both can block requests from a particular network. Trusted Advisor, Direct Connect, and Organizations do not filter web requests.

questions.question: Which of the following is a cloud architectural design principle?
questions.explanation: Loosely coupling components is a core cloud architectural design principle, improving resilience and scalability. Scaling up only, monolithic builds, and mandating commercial DB software are not recommended principles.

questions.question: Which service enables risk auditing by continuously monitoring and logging account activity, including user actions in the AWS Management Console and AWS SDKs?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudTrail continuously logs account activity and API calls (console, CLI, SDKs), enabling risk auditing. CloudWatch monitors metrics, Config tracks configuration, and Health reports events.

questions.question: Where can AWS compliance and certification reports be downloaded?
questions.explanation: AWS Artifact is where you download AWS compliance reports and certifications. Concierge is Enterprise billing support, Certificate Manager handles certs, and Trusted Advisor gives recommendations.

questions.question: The financial benefits of using AWS are: (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: The financial benefits of AWS include a reduced Total Cost of Ownership (A) and reduced operational expenditure/opex (C). AWS lowers (not increases) capital expenditure, and special startup payment terms are not core benefits.

questions.question: Which AWS service can serve a static website?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 can serve a static website directly from a bucket. Route 53 is DNS, QuickSight is BI, and X-Ray traces requests.

questions.question: What are the benefits of using the AWS Cloud for companies with customers in many countries around the world (Select TWO)

options.text: Companies can deploy applications in multiple AWS Regions to reduce latency.
Amazon Translate automatically translates third-party website interfaces into multiple languages.
Amazon CloudFront has multiple edge locations around the world to reduce latency.
Amazon Comprehend allows users to build applications that can respond to user requests in many languages.
Elastic Load Balancing can distribute application web traffic to multiple AWS Regions around the world which reduces latency.

questions.explanation: For global customers, you can deploy in multiple AWS Regions to reduce latency (A) and use Amazon CloudFront's worldwide edge locations to cache content near users (C). Translate/Comprehend are language services, and ELB does not span Regions.

questions.question: Which of the following are main components of the AWS global infrastructure? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Availability Zones (B) and Regions (D) are core components of the AWS global infrastructure. Resource groups, security groups, and AMIs are account-level constructs, not global infrastructure.

questions.question: What is the AWS customer responsible for according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation: Data encryption is the customer's responsibility under the Shared Responsibility Model. Physical access controls, secure device disposal, and environmental risk management are AWS responsibilities.

questions.question: If each department within a company has its own AWS account, what is one way to enable consolidated billing?

options.text: Use AWS Budgets on each account to pay only to budget.
Contact AWS Support for a monthly bill.
Create an AWS Organization from the payer account and invite the other accounts to join.
Put all invoices into one Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket, load data into Amazon Redshift, and then run a billing report.

questions.explanation: To enable consolidated billing, create an AWS Organization from the payer (management) account and invite the other accounts to join. Budgets, Support, and S3/Redshift reporting do not consolidate billing.

questions.question: What costs are included when comparing AWS Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) with on-premises TCO?
questions.explanation: A TCO comparison includes data center security costs (physical security) that AWS absorbs. Project management, antivirus licensing, and software development are not part of the infrastructure TCO comparison.

questions.question: What is the benefit of using AWS managed services, such as Amazon ElastiCache and Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS)?

options.text: They require the customer to monitor and replace failing instances.
They have better performance than customer-managed services.
They simplify patching and updating underlying OSs.
They do not require the customer to optimize instance type or size selections.

questions.explanation: Managed services like ElastiCache and RDS simplify patching and updating the underlying operating systems on your behalf. They do not require you to monitor/replace failing instances, are not inherently faster, and you still right-size instances.

questions.question: Which services can be used across hybrid AWS Cloud architectures? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Amazon Route 53 (A) and the Virtual Private Gateway (B) work across hybrid architectures (global DNS/routing and on-premises-to-VPC connectivity). A Classic Load Balancer, Auto Scaling, and default CloudWatch metrics operate within AWS.

questions.question: Which statement best describes Elastic Load Balancing?

options.text: It translates a domain name into an IP address using DNC.
It distributes incoming application traffic across one or more Amazon EC2 instances.
It collects metrics on connected Amazon EC2 instances.
It automatically adjusts the number of Amazon EC2 instances to support incoming traffic.

questions.explanation: Elastic Load Balancing distributes incoming application traffic across one or more EC2 instances (and other targets). DNS translation is Route 53, metric collection is CloudWatch, and instance-count adjustment is Auto Scaling.

questions.question: Which of the following is a fast and reliable NoSQL database service?
questions.explanation: Amazon DynamoDB is a fast, reliable, fully managed NoSQL database. Redshift is a data warehouse, RDS is relational, and S3 is object storage.

questions.question: Which AWS service would you use to obtain compliance reports and certificates?
questions.explanation: AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS compliance reports and certificates. Lambda runs code, Inspector scans for vulnerabilities, and Certificate Manager handles SSL/TLS certs.

questions.question: Which AWS services are defined as global instead of regional? (Select TWO)
questions.explanation: Amazon Route 53 (A) and Amazon CloudFront (D) are global services (not tied to one Region). EC2, S3, and DynamoDB are Regional services.

questions.question: How would an AWS customer easily apply common access controls to a large set of users?

options.text: Apply an IAM policy to an IAM group.
Apply an IAM policy to an IAM role.
Apply the same IAM policy to all IAM users with access to the same workload.
Apply an IAM policy to an Amazon Cognito user pool.

questions.explanation: Applying an IAM policy to an IAM group applies the same access controls to all users in that group, the easiest way to manage many users. Attaching policies per user or per role does not scale as cleanly here.

questions.question: Which of the following is an important architectural design principle when designing cloud applications?
questions.explanation: Using multiple Availability Zones is an important design principle for resilient cloud applications. Tight coupling, mandating open-source software, and over-provisioning are not.

questions.question: Which service allows a company with multiple AWS accounts to combine its usage to obtain volume discounts?
questions.explanation: AWS Organizations lets a company with multiple accounts combine usage (via consolidated billing) to qualify for volume discounts. Server Migration Service, Budgets, and Trusted Advisor do not aggregate usage for discounts.
